cn.t: Critics praise this high-octane adaptation of Dario Fo's political farce as urgently relevant and hilariously scathing. Daniel Rigby's astonishing performance and Tom Basden's sharp, gag-filled script deliver merciless satire of police corruption with breathless energy.
